---
title: "guard-tikz-figures 的 .qmd fixture"
format: pdf
---

只有 `{=latex}` raw block 裡的圖會被抽出來；圖的位置回報成 `\begin{tikzpicture}` 那一行，
標籤取同一個 figure 環境的 `\label`，沒有時取外層 Quarto 區塊的 `#fig-…`。

```{=latex}
\begin{figure}[H]
\centering
% expect: edge-through-node
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=8mm]
  \node[draw] (a) {A};
  \node[draw, right=of a] (b) {B};
  \node[draw, right=of b] (c) {C};
  \draw[->] (a) -- (c);
\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{連線穿過中間的節點}
\label{fig:through}
\end{figure}
```

::: {#fig-detour}
```{=latex}
% expect: none
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=8mm]
  \node[draw] (a) {A};
  \node[draw, right=of a] (b) {B};
  \node[draw, right=of b] (c) {C};
  \draw[->] (a.north) -- ++(0,4mm) -| (c.north);
\end{tikzpicture}
```

改走上方繞過中間的節點
:::

註解掉的圖、程式碼區塊裡的字都不算：

```{=latex}
% \begin{tikzpicture} \node {舊圖}; \end{tikzpicture}
```

```python
print(r"\begin{tikzpicture}")
```
